scope: G3 existing-facility feasibility/oracle preparation only; no production F
environment: WSL Ubuntu native ext4, Python3.10 stdlib, GNU tar1.34, Git2.34.1

hypotheses.question: Does GNU pax tar preserve complete regular/dir/symlink/hardlink byte set, full mode, mtime_ns, numeric owner, user xattrs and kernel POSIX ACL, including ignored/.git/attrs files?
hypotheses.expected: Source/restored independent lstat+raw bytes+readlink+xattr+hardlink groups exactly equal for declared support. Any mismatch remains a failure; default tar/filter omission is negative control. No source symlink follows.

hypotheses.question: Can raw archive bytes stored as ordinary Git blob under explicit commit/ref survive gc/prune while equivalent unrooted object is removed?
hypotheses.expected: Rooted archived content remains exact including ignored/export-ignore fixtures after gc; unrooted object removal demonstrates necessity. Host filter sentinel remains absent; no implicit git add/archive of user tree.

hypotheses.question: Can Linux read leases plus change watch reject old writable FD/mmap, observe ordinary edit attempts, and provide a bounded consistent base-inspection window?
hypotheses.expected: Report actual fcntl lease results and writer events; existing write FD and mapped writer must prevent unsafe capture or cause explicit failure. New writer attempt triggers break notification and is not treated as stable. No privilege/freeze assertion from flags alone.

hypotheses.question: Does same-filesystem renameat2(RENAME_EXCHANGE) exchange ordinary directory objects atomically, with old FD writes landing in retired old object rather than new current?
hypotheses.expected: Inode/object identities swap; fixed FD writes change only old tree; restart-observable names/identities determine performed exchange. This is filesystem primitive only, not R/X coordination proof.

fixture: Fresh bounded directories only; fixed small UTF8/binary/ignored/nested/empty/symlink/hardlink entries and optional exact kernel ACL fixture. No models/credentials/network. Source root remains within owned batch.
controls: Mismatch/missing observation rejected; non-rooted object and deliberately weakened metadata sample demonstrate false-success paths. Helpers only write their own fresh fixtures.
stop: One finite run per facility/case; each subprocess <=15s, whole probe bounded; preserve every failure/unsupported observation. Do not alter oracle after results.
